scientific_integrity: A self-contained proof treats all continuous candidate deviations; exact-grid checks are supporting tests, not proof of universal quantified statements. Self-review only; no independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three voter ideal-point masses, symmetric endpoints, cost CDF power q>=1; no claim for smooth electorate densities.
Pure equilibria and expected vote-share payoff, not mixed equilibrium or probability of winning.
title: Sharp three-bloc polarization threshold and turnout discontinuity in costly spatial voting
